messages:
emma: Heads-up - Vendor Y wants to remove /v1/batch-infer in favor of /v2/stream-infer. This breaks SDKs that expect synchronous batch semantics. Need partner coordination.
aj: Oof. Do we have telemetry on how many partners still call /v1/batch-infer vs using adapters? rough count will help scope.
rafael: Quick numbers: 7 partners hitting batch endpoint directly (including 2 marketplace adapters). Several SIs built retry+batch logic assuming single-response semantics.
claire: Risk: streaming returns incremental events (partial tokens) and different error/retry model. We'll need an adapter shim that buffers stream into a single batch response for flagged partners.
emma: Agree. Proposal: offer two compatibility options: 1) Gateway-buffer shim that converts v2 streaming -> v1 batch payload for flagged partners; 2) SDK patch that provides a client-side adapter. Gateway path preferred for quick coverage.
aj: Gateway can implement a per-partner "batch_compat" flag in routing config. It'll buffer until EOS or timeout and return consolidated JSON. We'll add metrics: compat.buffered_requests, compat.latency_penalty.
rafael: Marketplace: update integration manifest with "legacy_batch_supported": true/false and surface a banner about deprecation + migration doc. Also include a checkbox for partners to opt-in to shim during transition.
claire: Need an example adapter snippet for SDKs and a note about semantics (timeouts, memory). Small snippet for comms:

```
// SDK adapter: stream->batch
const resp = await client.streamInfer(req)
let buf = ''
for await (const chunk of resp) {
  buf += chunk.text
}
return { id: resp.id, result: buf }
```

Keep language-agnostic in docs.
emma: Timeline: enable shim + opt-in today, announce 90-day deprecation, canary rollout schedule: 2% traffic for 48h -> 20% for 96h -> full. After 90 days, turn off shim for non-opt-ins.
aj: I'll create runbook alerts for memory pressure (buffered requests), increased P95 latency, and unusual stream aborts. PagerDuty playbook for rollback.
rafael: For SIs, create a migration checklist: update SDK, adjust retry logic (stream aborts vs final errors), and test under partial-result scenarios. Offer 1:1 migration calls for top-3 partners.
partner-bot: Draft partner advisory scheduled for 2025-06-10 16:00 UTC (status: draft).
emma: Action items: aj -> routing flag + runbook + alerts; claire -> gateway shim + buffer limits + PR; rafael -> marketplace manifest change + partner outreach + SI migration sessions; emma -> coordinate vendor timeline and finalize deprecation copy with legal.
aj: Will post PR and runbook links when ready.
claire: Shim will add header "x-compat-batch" and emit metric tag "compat:stream_to_batch" so we can monitor. We'll include a memory cap of 8MB per buffered request and configurable timeout.
emma: Great. Let's aim to have shim live before vendor cutover. Posting updates in #partnerships-ops and will schedule partner sync meetings.
